title: Organiser Hub v2 Welcome — three locks
question: Organisers land here first, with a Gemini-star nav tab above Dashboard. Hero + old/new slider reveals stay. Pick the job of the page, the primary exit, and which compares lead.

options.label: Reveal tour → Dashboard
options.thesis: Persuade them the new hub is worth learning: stacked before/after sliders (Dashboard + Event hub from your screenshots) are the proof; yellow CTA exits into Dashboard.
options.viewport: Hero “Welcome to Organisers Hub v2!” fills first viewport with spark energy; scroll into two large drag-to-reveal stages; footer CTA Enter dashboard.
options.risk: Long page if every compare is full-bleed—cap at two hero-scale reveals, rest as optional chips.

options.label: One stage → Events
options.thesis: One cinematic old/new reveal owns the page (Event hub as the star); shorter copy; primary CTA goes to Events so they feel the new operate surface immediately.
options.viewport: Tight hero + one oversized slider stage; secondary link to Dashboard; star tab still permanent.
options.risk: Misses the analytics story if Dashboard never appears in the reveal.

options.label: What’s new hub → stay exploring
options.thesis: Permanent What’s new digest: hero plus multiple compact reveals (Dashboard, Event hub, Forms) they can revisit; soft CTA Explore dashboard, not a one-shot splash.
options.viewport: Hero + carousel or stacked compact reveal cards; always reachable from the star tab.
options.risk: Can feel like a changelog if the hero doesn’t stay celebratory.
